tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The page ground: candle paper by day, the sky twenty minutes after sunset by night. Every screen starts here.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, drawers, dialogs and table bodies: one step nearer the lamp than the page.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: table headers, command blocks, the rail a limit bar runs in.

tokens.name: paper-high
tokens.usage: The one surface lifted above a raised one (a menu over a drawer). Rare.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk and paper-high. Plum-black by day (starling sheen), moonpaper by night. 12.3 to 14.6 to 1 by day, 10.9 to 14.4 by night.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: notes under a value, timestamps, table meta. 5.1 to 6.0 to 1 on every paper by day, 6.0 to 7.9 by night.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between table rows and around cards. Decorative: it never carries meaning alone.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, quiet buttons, a selected card. 3.2 to 3.8 to 1 on every paper by day, 3.5 to 4.4 by night.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Starling violet: links, the primary button, the selected tab, the focus ring. Text in accent reads on every paper (5.9 to 7.0 by day, 6.3 to 8.2 by night).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: The primary button and a checked control under the pointer. on-accent reads on it 8.1 to 1 by day, 9.6 by night.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. 6.5 to 1 by day, 7.7 by night.

tokens.name: accent-field
tokens.usage: The lilac field behind a selected nav item or an accent pill. Accent text on it reads 5.1 to 1 by day, 5.2 by night.

tokens.name: lamp
tokens.usage: Lamplight: the one warm glow on a page (the you-are-here dot, the live marker, the lit bird in the flock). Decorative by day (2.4 to 1): never text on paper. At night it is also allowed as text (10.2 to 1).

tokens.name: on-lamp
tokens.usage: Text on a lamp fill: 5.6 to 1 by day, 10.2 by night.

tokens.name: field-mint
tokens.usage: Pastel field, mint sheen: the success fill, and a calm section ground.

tokens.name: field-butter
tokens.usage: Pastel field, butter: the waiting fill, the read-only banner.

tokens.name: field-rose
tokens.usage: Pastel field, dusk rose: the failure fill.

tokens.name: field-periwinkle
tokens.usage: Pastel field, periwinkle: the information fill, the running state.

tokens.name: field-lilac
tokens.usage: Pastel field, lilac: an alias of accent-field for illustration and section grounds.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Juniper: success text and dots. On field-mint 4.5 to 1 by day, 6.0 by night; on every paper 4.8 or more.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Marmalade: waiting and warning text. On field-butter 4.7 to 1 by day, 6.2 by night.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Rosehip: failure text. On field-rose 4.7 to 1 by day, 5.2 by night.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Midnight: information and running text. On field-periwinkle 4.7 to 1 by day, 6.0 by night.

tokens.name: stipple
tokens.usage: The engraving grain: dot texture on heroes and empty states, 4 to 6 percent of ink.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Display, for the landing page and documents

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page at most: the landing hero, the cover. Never inside the app: the dashboard sets every heading in Instrument Sans.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles on documents and the night report. Never inside the app: the dashboard sets every heading in Instrument Sans.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section titles in documents; dialog titles. Never inside the app: the dashboard sets every heading in Instrument Sans.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section heads on dashboard tabs; card titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each bird watches its seven nearest neighbours and nothing else.
styles.usage: All running text, table cells in documents, dialog copy.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dashboard table cells, notes under values, captions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Tile labels, form labels, pill words. Sentence case, never capitals.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The value on a tile: one figure, tabular.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Commands, paths, ids, log lines, numbers in tables.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Readouts under the flock, percentages beside a limit bar.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a dot and its word; inside a pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row; icon to label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between stacked fields; table cell side padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and tile padding; the phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between a section head and the next section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between sections of a document.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Around the hero flock; the top of a landing page.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inputs, command blocks, table wells: the smallest corner in the system. Nothing is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, tiles, the banner.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, drawers, dialogs: every surface that floats on the page.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The hero plate, the landing page's large fields, the flock's own frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, dots, the seven-dot loader.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: A control that cannot be pressed, always with its reason in the title.

tokens.name: opacity-trail
tokens.usage: The faint trail behind a bird in the hero flock.

meta.source: Designed for murmur in 2026: a murmuration of starlings; warm, crafted, scientific, slightly magical.
